approvalSource: explicit user instruction to remove space/user workspace subdomains, use direct ekodi.kr path namespaces consistently, preserve common/core/admin/My EKODI subdomain exceptions, and record the rule in the EKODI constitution
summary: Canonicalize person, organization, group and project spaces directly under ekodi.kr paths while reserving subdomains for justified system/common/core boundaries.
migrationPolicy: non-breaking; /people/{slug} redirects to /personal/{slug}, tenant-style /biz/{slug} redirects to /org/{slug}, and any deployed space.ekodi.kr or user.ekodi.kr alias redirects to the equivalent ekodi.kr path while preserving workspace_id as the canonical internal identity
rollbackPlan: revert the v1.1.0 constitution, machine-readable governance and validator commits; legacy aliases remain available so rollback does not require destructive DNS or identity changes
